senses.gloss: m. (supposed to be fr. Pers. pânah) protection, safeguard.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 103a:2">B. Kam. 103ᵃ</cite> <he>מידע … ופ׳ הוא דקבעינא</he> (Ms. M. <he>פנחייה</he>) you know very well that I bought the field for myself, and that (in buying it in behalf of a third, influential person) I had in view only protection (against legal disputes).

<cite ref="Yevamot 115b:7">Yeb. 115ᵇ</cite> <he>לפ׳ שבקיה</he> he left the letters that were to mark the contents as sacred on the vessel merely for protection (that it might be spared by thievish servants).
